title: Fix Flow Selected Node Active Color
description: Selected flow nodes are shown with a transparent/mixed version of active color. Use the same active (primary) color as everywhere else.
summary: Selected flow nodes used `nodeFillSelected`, a 28% primary/background mix in board theme tokens, so the WASM canvas painted a washed-out fill while handles and strokes already used full primary. Changed `nodeFillSelected` to `{ "token": "primary" }` for light and dark themes and regenerated styling artifacts so flow (and puzzle2d) receive solid active color via `serializeGraphVelloThemePaletteJson`.
